  • Rochdale’s own Stonehenge? What archaeologists actually know about the moorland stones Rochdale
    Surveys and excavations show Bronze Age cairns and widespread prehistoric flint scatters on the moors above Rochdale — but the idea of a local ‘Stonehenge’ is disputed and needs more professional…
  • Christmas At The Movies Rochdale

body:
8 new stories in the Rochdale borough since yesterday morning.

The stories:

Rochdale Council launches Christmas Toy Appeal for local children in need (Littleborough). The Christmas Toy Appeal aims to support local children living in poverty by collecting donations until 11 December.

Man seriously injured in attack on Boundary Street, Rochdale (Rochdale). A man was seriously injured in an attack on Boundary Street in Rochdale on 8 November 2026.

Rochdale’s own Stonehenge? What archaeologists actually know about the moorland stones (Rochdale). Surveys and excavations show Bronze Age cairns and widespread prehistoric flint scatters on the moors above Rochdale — but the idea of a local ‘Stonehenge’ is disputed and needs more professional…

Christmas At The Movies (Rochdale). Something special is coming to Rochdale Town Hall this Christmas! Shaun the Sheep, festive film favourites and the spectacular sound of a live brass band… all in one magical afternoon!

Middleton man charged with assaulting emergency worker after Lodge Street stop (Middleton). Lee Cartledge, 42, faces four charges following a vehicle stop in Middleton on Wednesday 11 November, Greater Manchester Police said.

New handmade lock gates installed at Rochdale Canal in Manchester (Rochdale). Handcrafted oak gates have been craned into place at Lock 80 on the Rochdale Canal, replacing gates over 25 years old.

Rochdale AFC to host York City in League Two clash this Saturday (Rochdale). Rochdale AFC welcomes York City to the Crown Oil Arena for a Sky Bet League Two match this Saturday, 12 November.

Prime Minister Andy Burnham supports reinstatement of Heywood express bus service (Heywood). Andy Burnham backs calls for the return of the 167 bus service from Heywood to Manchester, which was cut in 2012.

Weather: Partly cloudy 5°C in Rochdale today.
